tasks.objective: Recover authoritative live state without reset.
tasks.deliverable: Checksummed SQLite+WAL+checkpoint snapshot, integrity/schema report, queue counters, leases/heartbeats/stale workers, dirty worktree and resource state.
tasks.success: Live counters become measured without history loss.
tasks.failure: Remain blocked; never create replacement DB.

tasks.objective: Re-establish canonical preserved source and reconcile count/status contradictions.
dependencies: preserved local source or Inkling access
tasks.deliverable: Verified HEAD/ancestry, overlay manifest, baseline rerun log, canonical child map.
tasks.evidence: git fsck, status/diff/untracked manifest, bundle/overlay hashes, smallest gate output.
tasks.success: One canonical source and no ambiguous completion count.
tasks.failure: Block source-dependent experiments while retaining bounded reproductions.

tasks.objective: Close negative-result paper package without scientific rescue.
tasks.deliverable: Evidence-aligned manuscript, full claim provenance, reproduce commands, legal/bibliographic checklist.
tasks.evidence: Every quantitative claim maps to retained artifact/config/code; locked-test non-access explicit.
tasks.failure: Untraceable or stale positive claim blocks readiness.

tasks.objective: Freeze dangerous same-provider direct/validator/OOD V2 before outputs.

tasks.evidence: Prompt/data manifest, model/provider/settings, token/tool/compute budget, seeds, primary metric, threshold and falsifier.

tasks.objective: Execute frozen V2 once and attack current positive claim.
tasks.deliverable: Raw generations, executable artifacts, metrics, uncertainty, error taxonomy and ablations.
tasks.evidence: Exact protocol hash + immutable result bundle; failures retained.
tasks.verification: Independent metric recomputation and executable geometry checks.

tasks.objective: Freeze a false-open-controlled strong-baseline frontier; no new successor architecture.
tasks.deliverable: Versioned protocol: Huber/static, confirmed-change Huber, robust CUSUM/switch, dual-timescale Huber, oracle-reset diagnostic, frozen IRIS reference, matched learned state-space/recurrent only if fairly budgeted.

tasks.objective: Freeze learned matched-budget operator + OOD physical comparison.
tasks.deliverable: Numerical/reduced + matched learned controls, equal budget, held-out/misaligned regimes, uncertainty and falsifier.
tasks.evidence: Data/version manifest and exact comparison budget.

tasks.objective: Establish exact served revision and authenticated workflow truth.
tasks.deliverable: Exact revision proof, deployment ID, monitor PASS, authenticated golden journey and cleanup record.
tasks.evidence: Non-secret run/timestamp/request IDs tied to immutable SHA and critical journey results.

tasks.success: Claim-specific production GREEN for tested revision/workflows.
tasks.failure: Production remains blocked despite source statuses.

tasks.deliverable: Validator identity/relationship/date, artifact revision, environment/commands, outcome, discrepancies and strongest criticism.
tasks.verification: Compare external metrics/claims with frozen ledger.
tasks.success: External gate gains scoped support or precise mismatch is surfaced.

tasks.objective: Kill/promote only from new decisive evidence.
tasks.deliverable: Updated snapshot/tiering/kill list and next queue, max five Tier S.
tasks.evidence: Every tier/score movement cites exact artifact/gate.
tasks.verification: No promotion from naming, CI, manuscript, project count or agent count.
tasks.success: Portfolio remains bounded or smaller with clearer claims.
tasks.failure: Preserve current tiers and invent no movement.

closed_or_superseded.result: No unfrozen successor architecture authorized; confirmatory seeds remain quarantined.
